title: Cumulative confirmed gravitational-wave black hole mergers detected

source.name: Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC)
source.publisher: LIGO Scientific Collaboration / Virgo Collaboration / KAGRA Collaboration

notes: First detection (GW150914) announced 2015. GWTC-1 (2019) totaled 11 confident events from the O1/O2 runs. GWTC-3 (2021), covering through the O3 run, brought the running total to about 90. GWTC-5.0, announced by LIGO in 2026, brings the cumulative total of confirmed gravitational-wave events to 390. Figures are the collaboration's own published cumulative catalog counts.
